en.headline: Xia Baolong hears briefings on relevant work situations in Shenzhen
en.dek: The Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office said the director attended the session on Sunday with Xu Qifang present, without disclosing the agenda.
body: Xia Baolong, deputy head of the Central Leading Group on Hong Kong and Macao Affairs and director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office, heard briefings on relevant work situations in Shenzhen on Sunday, the office said.
Xu Qifang, the executive deputy director who handles day-to-day operations at the Central Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office and the State Council Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office, also attended.
The office did not disclose specific agenda items or the identities of those who gave the briefings. The announcement came days before the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting is scheduled in Shenzhen.

zh.headline: 夏寶龍在深圳聽取有關工作情況匯報
zh.dek: 港澳辦表示，主任周日在深圳聽取匯報，徐啟方出席，未有公布具體議程。
body: 中央港澳工作領導小組副組長、港澳辦主任夏寶龍周日在深圳聽取有關工作情況匯報，港澳辦公布。
中央港澳工作辦公室及國務院港澳事務辦公室分管日常工作的副主任徐啟方亦有出席。
港澳辦未有透露匯報的具體議程或匯報者身份。消息在亞太經合組織領導人會議將於深圳舉行前數日公布。
